title: 第十七章：哼！我再不跟你玩儿了（上）
content_zh:
那人心中虽然稍稍有些讶异，但却并未表露，随意的一瞥，便立即判断了出来，眼前这几个小孩子，虽然倒地翻滚，痛苦难当，但却没有真正的受什么伤害，只要回家静养一段时间便再无妨碍。

    “呀！赵叔叔，你看，那个黑马小子是不是要死了？”一道沙哑的声音顿时传遍全场，但却与沙哑声音不符的是，所说的话却是稍显幼稚。

    贺峰虽然痛苦不已，但是听到这道沙哑的声音，而问的话却显得这么幼稚，也不禁抬起头看了看，这一看不禁愣在了当场，看那遥指而出的纤纤素手，再看那红扑扑的小圆脸，还有那水灵灵的大眼睛，又是一个祸国殃民的祸水？不不不，人家还是个孩子，不能这样说，影响不好，为什么是“又”，因为前面已经见到了一个聂初影了。

    贺峰虽然有些惊讶这么个娇小可爱、天真活泼的小姑娘怎么会有这么个公鸭嗓子，但他比起这周围的众人，毕竟也算是见过“大场面”的了，自己的惊讶与呆愣并没有保持多久，不过，贺峰这一副惊讶呆愣的模样，却已全数落在了那个说话的小姑娘眼中，只见她慢慢的昂起了头，挺起了胸，一副傲视群雄的模样，只看她现在的样子，贺峰就知道，她现在自我感觉一定很骄傲，虽然不知道为什么。

    再顺着她手指的方向一看，贺峰不禁又是一愣，那个“黑马小子”，竟然是他自己。贺峰心中尴尬不已，心想：想自己堂堂七尺男儿，现在竟然被一个两三岁的小姑娘喊自己“黑马小子”，真是“叔能忍，婶也不能忍了”，虽然自己的高大威猛，只是在灵魂这一高端层次上，但自己的外在也不是她一小姑娘能藐视的。

    “愣什么愣呢？说你呢，黑马小子，要不要本公子大发慈悲救你一命啊？”又是一道沙哑的声音传来，不仅很是得意，而且还十分享受这种说话的方式，甚至在那天真的关心之中还带着那么一丝的调侃。

    为了表达自己内心的不满与幽怨，贺峰决定还是低着头抱自己的肚子算了，虽然现在已经不怎么疼了，但他担心再看下去，肚子会再次要命的疼起来，他可不想没被人打的晕过去，最后却让自己笑的晕过去，那就真的闹大笑话了。纵观前世今生，他堂堂“黑面杀神”何曾在混战厮杀中笑过？

    “韵儿，不要胡说”旁边的那个一身学生素袍的漂亮男生说道，虽然话语之中有训诫之意，但声音听来中正平和，不如女子那般细腻，却也不像男人那般粗犷，让人听来，只觉如沐春风，就连心情在不觉间也轻快舒爽了几分，“这位小哥儿，韵儿无邪之语，不要介意，我看还是赶进要几位裁判将几位小哥儿送回家养伤罢，莫要耽误了身子。”

    几位裁判一听这位书生装扮的人的安排，便立即分别来到了贺峰等几人的身边，一人一个就要架着各回各家，不了这是贺峰却又说话了。

    诚然，贺峰在思考着一个很严重的问题，他到底是要喊这个年轻的书生叔叔好，还是喊大哥好呢？唉，算了，人家都喊自己“小哥儿”了，做人要懂得礼尚往来，要懂得相互尊重，不能把别人喊老了，没听到前世人家见到一为五十岁大妈，还要热切地喊一声美女、大姐什么的吗？

    “这位大哥，谢谢了，不过，我们可不能就这样回去，谁输谁赢都还没定呢？今天回去了，改天他们要是在找我挑战，那您说我是不接呢，还是不接呢？”

    “哈哈•••，你这小孩儿，说话倒也有些意思，那好，等你们把胜负决定了以后，我再请几位裁判把你们送回家去，我也想要看看，你们都要站不起来了，还要用什么样的方式来结束这次挑战。”似是没有听过如贺峰这般说的俏皮话，轻轻笑了几声，便神色欢愉的做了决定。

    这个时候，除了李纯眼中闪烁着兴奋的光芒，金灿和云鸿飞俱是一脸的愁苦，金灿的腿现在还麻着呢，只是较刚才轻了许多，但依然有些行动不便，而云鸿飞全身平躺着向着地上猛地一摔，浑身疼痛也就算了，重要的是全身像是散了架一般，一点力气也提不起来，让他如何再跟贺峰打上一场？更何况，头在地上的那一撞，着实不轻，直到现在可都还没怎么缓过劲儿来呢。

    贺峰可不管别人是什么样的反应，他现在正在强忍着疼痛站起来，虽然坐在地上的时候，并不觉得怎么疼了，但是站起来就又是一回事了，肚子又开始钻心的疼了起来，要不是他有着三十多岁的灵魂存在这个看起来十分弱小的身体内，让他强忍着没有出声，说不定他现在已经哭着大喊：“赶紧送我回家，疼死我了”。

    贺峰晃悠悠的走到金灿面前，金灿都坐起来好一会了，在贺峰看来，金灿的威胁还是要远大于云鸿飞的。

    “说吧，是要我把你打到认输，还是你自己直接认输”贺峰站在金灿三步开外的距离，开声问道，不是贺峰太过于谨慎，而是现在贺峰的状态，如果一旦被一个突袭打倒，能不能再站起来，连贺峰都没有信心，所以贺峰才会这么小心的要自己与金灿之间一定要保持一定的距离。

    金灿神色复杂的看了看站在离自己还有三步距离的贺峰，心想：他一定也是浑身疼痛难忍，，一定是！要不然不会坐在地上那么长时间不动。认输？不是不可以，只是不甘心，不甘心自己一堂堂八岁男儿，今天竟然要想一个两岁大的小屁孩认输？不甘心这场挑战是自己发出的，现在却是以自己认输而结局；不甘心自己五个人竟然没有答应对方两个；不甘心啊，因为有太多的不甘心，所以他不想认输，他想最后拼一把，他想，就算最后输了，自己也要输的豪气万丈！认输？去他妈的认输！老子不认！！

    金灿咬着牙，抿着嘴，红着眼，胸口不断起伏，不知道是因为内心因不甘而激动的情绪，还是因为浑身的疼痛，使得他在站起来的过程中，不断地喘着粗气，脸上满是细密的汗珠。

    在金灿站起来的过程中，贺峰一直在旁边看着，说实话，一个八岁大的孩子，哪怕有过炼体两年的底子垫着，能做到这一步，已经远非常人所能比得了的了，但贺峰并不是一个正人君子，也从未想过要做一个正人君子，他真的很想动手，将金灿打倒在地，这一次站的那么艰难，想必下一次就再也站不起来了吧。只是他还要顾及旁边那个身份很大牌的“书生”，书生嘛，心中总是会有一些什么浩然正气之类的，虽然不明白那到底是一种什么气儿，但并不表示贺峰不明白，一旦触动了书生身上那个浩然正气的开关，那可就真的是一发不可收拾了。

    就在金灿刚刚站起来，身子还在摇晃，贺峰发现自己的机会来了，他觉得自己可以动手了，因为金灿已经站起来了，至于有没有站稳，那就是他自己的事了，跟自己可扯不上斑点关系，难道还要自己过去扶他一把，然后再说一声：您当心，我要打您了。完全是在开玩笑嘛，傻子都不会这么干！

    “虽然你输了，但我很佩服你，真的！”贺峰在动手之前，决定还是说些什么吧，也算是一个提醒，为了让所有人都知道自己的英雄豪气，他的声音特意提的很高，他希望所有人都听到自己这个善良的提醒，尽管有些困难。况且，内心深处，贺峰也确实有些佩服这个只有八岁的小男孩儿。

    猛夸两步，跳起，前扑，一切都那么的快，快到这一刻贺峰似乎都有些感觉不到疼痛了，真没没想到神经也有麻木的时候，原以为只有感情才会麻木的。

    金灿在刚站起，甚至都还没站直身子的时候，就听到了贺峰很大声的说了句话，声音很大，说的也很快，他都还没想明白贺峰到底说了些什么，就猛地看到贺峰那不断靠近放大的身影。躲？身形未稳，怎么躲，难道要自己趴地上，再等着贺峰砸？档？，怎么挡，自己站着都费劲，何况现在站都还没站稳呢？

    贺峰现在心中也是有些打鼓，毕竟撞起来，两个人都会疼，贺峰也是害怕自己这一撞下去，连带着自己也站不起来了，那可就难堪了，人家可还没认输呢。不过，当他看到了金灿那呆愣无措的模样，心中终于有好受了些。

    “啊”两种不同的声音，汇集成一道传了出来。

    贺峰双手叠在肚子前方，就这样扑了过去，他实在是怕一会不小心再撞到肚子，在他下意识里，就算这次撞到头，也不能撞到头，他实在是受不了那种钻心的疼了。而金灿则是双腿一前一后的岔开，双手护在胸前，等着贺峰撞上来。

    跪求票票啊、、、
content_en:
Although the man was a little surprised, he did not show it. With a casual glance, he immediately judged that although the children in front of him fell to the ground and rolled around in excruciating pain, they were not really hurt. As long as they went home to rest for a while, they would be fine.
"Ah! Uncle Zhao, look, is that dark horse boy going to die?" A hoarse voice suddenly spread throughout the audience, but what was inconsistent with the hoarse voice was that the words he said were slightly childish.
Although He Feng was in pain, but when he heard the hoarse voice and the question seemed so childish, he couldn't help but raise his head and look. He couldn't help but froze on the spot, looking at the slender hand pointing out from a distance, then looking at the red round face, and the big watery eyes. Is this another disaster that brings disaster to the country and the people?No, no, no, I'm still a child, I can't say that, it won't have a good impact, why is it "again", because I have already seen Nie Chuying before.
Although He Feng was a little surprised how such a petite, cute, innocent and lively girl could have such a drake voice, but compared to everyone around him, he had seen "big scenes" after all. His surprise and stunnedness did not last long. However, He Feng's look of surpriseThe stunned look was all in the eyes of the little girl who spoke. She slowly raised her head and chest, looking arrogant. Just looking at her current appearance, He Feng knew that she must feel very proud of herself now, although he didn't know why.
Looking in the direction of her finger again, He Feng couldn't help but was stunned again. That "dark horse boy" turned out to be himself.He Feng felt extremely embarrassed and thought to himself: He thought that he was a tall and dignified man, but now he was called "dark horse boy" by a two or three-year-old girl. "Uncle can bear it, but aunt can't stand it anymore." Although he was tall and mighty only at the high-end level of his soul, his appearance was not something that she, a little girl, could despise.
"Why are you so stunned? What about you, Black Horse Boy, do you want me to show mercy and save your life?" Another hoarse voice came, not only very proud, but also enjoying this way of speaking, even with a hint of ridicule in his innocent concern.
In order to express his inner dissatisfaction and resentment, He Feng decided to lower his head and hug his stomach. Although it didn't hurt much now, he was worried that if he continued to watch, his stomach would hurt terribly again. He didn't want to pass out without being beaten, but in the end he fainted from laughing, which would really make a big joke.Throughout his past and present lives, has he, the majestic “Black-faced God of Killing,” ever smiled in a melee?
"Yun'er, don't talk nonsense," said the beautiful boy next to him in a plain student robe. Although there was a warning in his words, his voice sounded fair and gentle. It was not as delicate as a woman's, but not as rough as a man's. It sounded like,I felt like a spring breeze, and even my mood became a little lighter and relaxed without realizing it. "This little brother, don't mind Yun'er's innocent words. I think it's better to rush in and ask some referees to send these little brothers home to recuperate. Don't waste your time."
As soon as the referees heard the arrangement of the man dressed as a scholar, they immediately came to the side of He Feng and the others. Each one of them had to carry them back to their respective homes, but they didn't realize that it was He Feng who spoke again.
Admittedly, He Feng was thinking about a very serious question. Should he call this young scholar uncle or eldest brother?Oh, forget it, people call me "little brother". As a person, you must know how to be courteous and respect each other, and you must not call others old. Didn't you hear that in the previous life, when people saw a fifty-year-old aunt, they would eagerly call her "beautiful lady" or "big sister"?
"Big brother, thank you, but we can't just go back like this without deciding who will win or lose? I went back today. If they challenge me another day, do you think I won't accept it or not?"
"Haha..., you kid, your words are interesting. Well, after you decide the outcome, I'll ask a few referees to send you home. I also want to see how you can end this challenge even if you can't stand up." He seemed to have never heard such witty words as He Feng, so he chuckled a few times and made his decision with a happy expression.
At this time, except for the excited light shining in Li Chun's eyes, Jin Can and Yun Hongfei both had sad faces. Jin Can's legs were still numb, but they were much lighter than before, but they still had some difficulty in moving. Yun Hongfei was lying flat on his back and suddenly fell to the ground. Forget about the pain all over his body, the important thing was that his whole body seemed to fall apart and he couldn't lift up any strength. How could he fight with He Feng again?What's more, the collision of his head on the ground was really not light, and he still hasn't recovered much from it until now.
He Feng didn't care what other people's reactions were. He was standing up despite the pain. Although he didn't feel much pain when he was sitting on the ground, standing up was another matter. His stomach began to hurt again. If he hadn't had a thirty-year-old soul in this seemingly very weak body, which made him hold back and keep silent, he might have cried and shouted: "Send me home quickly, it hurts me so much."
He Feng wandered up to Jin Can. Jin Can sat up for a while. In He Feng's view, Jin Can's threat was still far greater than Yun Hongfei's.
"Tell me, do you want me to beat you until you give in, or do you just give in?" He Feng stood three steps away from Jin Can and asked loudly. It was not that He Feng was too cautious, but because of He Feng's current state, if he was knocked down by a surprise attack, he would not be able to stand up again. Even He Feng did not have the confidence to stand up again, so He Feng was so careful to keep a certain distance between himself and Jin Can.
Jin Can looked at He Feng who was standing three steps away from him with a complicated expression, and thought: He must be in unbearable pain all over his body, it must be!Otherwise, I wouldn’t have sat on the ground without moving for such a long time.Give up?It's not that I can't, it's just that I'm not willing to accept it. I don't want to accept that I am an eight-year-old boy. Today, I want to give up to a two-year-old brat?He is unwilling to accept that this challenge was initiated by himself, but now it ends with him admitting defeat; he is unwilling to accept that the five of him did not agree to two of the other parties; he is unwilling to accept it, because there are too many unwillingnesses, so he does not want to admit defeat, he wants to give it a final try, and he thinks that even if he loses in the end, he will lose with great pride!Give up?Fuck you and throw in the towel!I don’t recognize it!!
Jin Can gritted his teeth, pursed his lips, his eyes were red, and his chest kept rising and falling. He didn't know whether it was because of the excitement in his heart due to unwillingness, or because of the pain all over his body, which made him gasp for breath while standing up, and his face was covered with beads of sweat.
While Jin Can stood up, He Feng watched from the side. To be honest, an eight-year-old child, even with two years of physical training, could achieve this step, which is far beyond the reach of ordinary people. But He Feng is not a gentleman, and he has never thought about being a gentleman. He really wants to take action and knock Jin Can to the ground. It was so difficult to stand this time, and he will probably not be able to stand up again next time.It's just that he still has to take care of the famous "scholar" next to him. Scholars always have some kind of awe-inspiring righteousness in their hearts. Although he doesn't understand what kind of aura it is, it doesn't mean that He Feng doesn't understand. Once the switch of the scholar's awe-inspiring righteousness is triggered, it will really be out of control.
Just when Jin Can stood up and his body was still swaying, He Feng realized that his opportunity had come. He felt that he could take action because Jin Can had already stood up. As for whether he stood firm or not, that was his own business. It had nothing to do with him. Should he go over to help him and then say: Be careful, I'm going to hit you.This is all a joke, no fool would do this!
"Although you lost, I admire you, really!" Before taking action, He Feng decided to say something. It was also a reminder. In order to let everyone know his heroic spirit, his voice was raised very high. He hoped that everyone would hear his kind reminder, even though it was somewhat difficult.Moreover, deep down in his heart, He Feng did admire this little boy who was only eight years old.
He took two fierce steps, jumped up, and rushed forward, everything was so fast. At this moment, He Feng seemed to be unable to feel the pain. He didn't expect that his nerves would also be numb. He thought that only emotions could be numb.
Jin Can had just stood up, and before he could even stand up straight, he heard He Feng say something very loudly and very quickly. Before he could understand what He Feng said, he suddenly saw He Feng's enlarged figure that was getting closer and closer.hide?How can I hide when my body is not stable? Do I have to lie down on the ground and wait for He Feng to hit me?files?, no matter how you block it, it’s hard to stand on your own, not to mention that you haven’t even stood firm yet?
He Feng was also a little worried now. After all, if they collided, both of them would be hurt. He Feng was also afraid that he would be knocked down and he would not be able to stand up. That would be embarrassing. He has not given up yet.However, when he saw Jin Can's dazed look, he finally felt better.
"Ah" two different voices came together into one voice.
He Feng folded his hands in front of his stomach and rushed forward. He was really afraid of accidentally hitting his stomach again. In his subconscious, even if he hit his head this time, he couldn't hit his head. He really couldn't stand the excruciating pain.Jin Can, on the other hand, spread his legs forward and back, protecting his chest with his hands, waiting for He Feng to hit him.
I'm begging for votes...
title_en: Chapter 17: Humph!I won’t play with you anymore (Part 1)
